behavior: On a PR that closes an issue, CI emits an advisory report naming every other open issue whose title or body references a production file in the diff, and which file matched.
Red-tested against #851: replaying its changed-file list against #849-open flags it, and matching runs over unstripped text so reusing _strip_markdown_code goes red.
The report is advisory: a PR with adjacent issues exits with the same status it would have exited with without them.
verification: bats tests/spec-gate-adjacency.bats -f 'cannot change the exit status'
